verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's docs say it can analyze data, make interactive visualizations, and produce downloadable documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs, and Codex can run commands. However, no doc states that the chat assistant writes and executes code on uploaded data to produce charts or computed answers; that link is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation of code execution on user data in chat (a code interpreter or sandbox), evidence that charts are generated by executed code, independent hands-on corroboration of data-analysis runs.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant write and run code on my data to produce charts, computed answers, and downloadable files
